title: New website: separate pages, mobile layout and intro
text: Our website now has its own pages for About, Vision & Mission, Services, Team and Contact, a layout built for phones first, and a short animated intro on the homepage.

title: Website rebuilt with React and TypeScript
text: We moved the site to React and TypeScript with a redesigned navbar, hero, services, team and contact sections, plus an interactive terminal in the hero.

title: New logo and brand colours
text: DenkByte got its lightbulb logo and the navy and orange colour theme you see across the site.

title: DenkByte is online
text: Our team of nine started building the DenkByte company website as part of the Planspiel Web Engineering project at TU Chemnitz.
